column7: Sunday{{efn|This was the first scheduled regular season meeting of the Colts and the Cardinals in St. Louis since [[1978 Baltimore Colts season|1978]], when the Colts were based in Baltimore. The Colts didn’t play again in St. Louis until [[2001 Indianapolis Colts season|2001]], when they played against [[2001 St. Louis Rams season|the Rams]].|name=|group=}}
column11: Sunday{{efn|This was the first scheduled regular season game between the Dolphins and the Giants since [[1972 Miami Dolphins season|the Dolphins’ 1972]] [[perfect season]]. As of 1972 they were scheduled to meet in 1977, but this meeting was cancelled so [[1977 Miami Dolphins season|the Dolphins]] could play [[1977 Seattle Seahawks season|the Seahawks]] and [[1977 New York Giants season|the Giants]] play [[1977 Tampa Bay Buccaneers season|the Buccaneers]]. Miami and the Giants finally played their second-ever regular season game [[1990 Miami Dolphins season|in 1990]].|name=|group=}}
